title: Concept: API collection published with the app
description: A Postman collection document in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The collection lists every request with its headers and example bodies, which is a curated map of the API including calls the interface never makes.
applicability: Deployments that render a Postman collection document into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The collection lists every request with its headers and example bodies, which is a curated map of the API including calls the interface never makes.
